notes.title: Announcement on keyboard settings and Chinese version translation correction
notes.notes: Hello, all Chinese players of ”Touhou Sky Arena”, how are you playing? There are currently two problems with the Chinese version of the game. The first is that the game keyboard cannot be customized. We are working hard to resolve this point. The second is that there is an error in some Chinese translations. After our inspection, we found that some translations used the wrong proofreading version. The repair process has now entered. We hereby apologize for the bad gaming experience brought to all players, and thank you for your support and understanding of "Touhou Sky Arena".
